speaker: Doctor
text: That previous assessment of cellulitis seems inconsistent with your description of pain worsening with movement and lack of skin changes or fever, as cellulitis typically presents with redness, warmth, and swelling. To better evaluate the joint structure and rule out calcific tendinitis or other pathologies, REQUEST TEST: Shoulder_MRI and please REQUEST IMAGES of the left shoulder. Did you notice any specific "popping" sound or sudden loss of strength when the pain first began?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder). The normal X-ray and MRI, combined with your diabetes history, pain at end-range of motion, and absence of skin changes or systemic infection signs, rule out cellulitis, fracture, and rotator cuff tear.
